title: wulffhound surface-energy dataset
description: Three record types, one per line of dataset/*.jsonl. 'surface_energy': the unit of record, one computed surface energy (one material, force field, facet, termination and protocol) with its result and provenance. 'wulff_shape': a derived record, the Wulff shape of one material x force field x temperature x level x facet set, built from surface_energy records (listed by id); since 0.2.0 also, with construction 'attachment_energy', the growth (attachment-energy) morphology built from attachment_energy records. 'attachment_energy' (0.2.0): the static Hartman-Perdok attachment energy of one facet family's growth slice (material, force field, facet, slice, the energies with their gas-reference convention, flags, provenance), in kcal/mol per molecule. Units: gamma in mJ/m^2, lengths in angstrom, temperatures in K, density in g/cm^3, masses in g/mol. Miller indices are always in the setting of the record's own cell (facet.setting); two structures of one material can use different settings. Flagged records are kept; their flags say what is wrong and how severe it is.

schema_version.description: 0.1.1 (additive): provenance source campaign (the campaign driver), flag code sim2l_flag. 0.2.0 (additive): record type attachment_energy; wulff_shape.construction (wulff, the default, or attachment_energy) with level ae-static and facets carrying E_att and distance; provenance source attachment-prototype; flag codes cut_rules_disagree, qeq_charges_changed, intramolecular_strain_in_reference, growth_morphology

flag.description: One flag on a gamma or a shape. severity 'error': the value is not usable as a surface energy (kept, marked, left out of shapes); 'warning': usable with care; 'info': context a reader needs. Attachment-energy flags (0.2.0): cut_rules_disagree (the lowest-|E_att| cut is not the lowest-gamma cut), qeq_charges_changed (ReaxFF: QEq re-equilibrates the charges of the isolated slice, so E_att includes their response), intramolecular_strain_in_reference (the static molecules are strained against the minimised gas molecule: the static E_latt includes it, E_att does not), growth_morphology (a shape built from attachment energies: kinetic, not equilibrium).

by.description: who raised it: surfenergy (its gamma_flags guard), wulffhound-guard (engine.consistency), exporter (this dataset's curation), engine, campaign driver, attachment ingest (the exporter reading the attachment-energy results)

material_id.description: one crystal form of one compound (compound + polymorph); several structures (sources, settings) may share it

structure_id.description: the structure the cells were built from, e.g. cod-2104364 or ccdc-1225494

distributed.description: true when the structure file itself is in this repository (CC0 only); the dataset never carries atomic coordinates

density.description: g/cm^3 from Z, the formula and the cell volume

lattice_matrix.description: rows a, b, c in Cartesian angstrom, the data-file orientation (a along x, b in the xy plane)

md5.description: md5 of the force-field file (ReaxFF) or of the LAMMPS script that defines it (non-reactive)

hkl.description: the member of the family that was cut

family_members.description: the orbit of the family under the Laue class of the data-file setting

d_eff.description: d_hkl divided by the extinction factor (BFDH)

equivalent_indices.description: terminations of the same group (same cut by symmetry); their gamma is this record's

gap.description: z gap of the cut, angstrom

faces_equivalent.description: false when the top and bottom faces of the slab differ: gamma is then their average

is_lowest.description: true for the lowest unrelaxed gamma of the facet in its run (the one a level-1 facet value and a level-2 relaxation use)

level.description: 1 unrelaxed cut (screening), 2 relaxed at T = 0 (energy minimisation), 3 MD at T > 0

energy_check.description: supercell's oriented-cell energy check was run

gamma.description: excess potential energy of the two surfaces per area (mJ/m^2); null when the run failed

gamma_unrelaxed.description: level 2/3: the unrelaxed gamma of the same termination

gamma_raw.description: the value the Sim2L itself reported when this record's gamma replaces it (see gamma_basis)

source.description: campaign: a job of the campaign driver (dataset/campaigns/<name>.jsonl); attachment-prototype: the chain's static attachment-energy prototype (devtools/attachment; its results JSON is read by the exporter)

source_ref.description: where the value is recorded: file and entry (e.g. data/tnt/ledger.json#entries[3])

revision.description: chain git revision or nanoHUB revision

run_id.description: the run folder id (simtool run hash or wulffhound run name)

run_ref.description: portable reference of the run folder (chain:..., state:...); not shipped

date.description: ISO date or date-time of the run (or of the record when the run time is not known)

ae_cut.description: one candidate cut of a growth slice: a gap between the molecular layers taken modulo d_eff

cut_z.description: angstrom along the facet normal of the oriented cell

gamma_unrelaxed.description: mJ/m^2: the unrelaxed gamma of the 2-period slab of this cut (slabcutter's slab of that termination)

attachment_energy.description: The static (unrelaxed) attachment energy of one facet family: E_att = e_bulk - e_slice per molecule, the energy released when one growth slice of thickness d_eff (d_hkl / extinction factor, as BFDH) attaches to the crystal. The growth rate of the face is taken proportional to |E_att| (Hartman-Perdok). E_latt = E_slice + E_att; E_slice and E_latt need a gas reference (result.energy_convention), E_att does not. Units kcal/mol per molecule. No coordinates: energies, cut heights and slice sizes only.

extinction_factor.description: n, from the systematic absences of the space group in the data-file setting

extinction_factor_structural.description: the largest n for which the atom-height profile of the oriented cell repeats after d_hkl / n (a check: equal to extinction_factor)

n_slice.description: molecules in one slice: the whole molecules whose centres of mass lie in [cut, cut + d_eff)

cut_index.description: the growth slice: the cut chosen by rule

rule.description: lowest_abs_E_att: the most strongly bound slice (Hartman-Perdok's choice)

lowest_gamma_cut_index.description: the cut with the lowest unrelaxed 2-period gamma (its E_att: result.E_att_lowest_gamma_cut)

E_att.description: attachment energy of the growth slice (slice.cut_index); negative = bound

E_att_lowest_gamma_cut.description: E_att of the lowest-gamma cut (= E_att when the two rules agree)

gamma_unrelaxed_min.description: mJ/m^2: the lowest unrelaxed 2-period gamma over the cuts (the family's level-1 value in this dataset)

E_slice.description: slice energy per molecule against the gas reference of energy_convention

E_latt.description: lattice energy per molecule against the same reference (= E_slice + E_att)

energy_convention.description: gas reference of E_slice and E_latt. static_minus_minimised_gas: static crystal minus the minimised isolated molecule (includes intramolecular strain); rigid: minus the molecule frozen in its crystal geometry (intermolecular energy only, the classical HABIT convention); relaxed: the bulk minimised at fixed box minus the minimised molecule

e_bulk_per_molecule.description: static energy per molecule of the oriented bulk cell (force-field zero)

e_bulk_minus_unitcell.description: oriented cell minus unit cell, per molecule (a check, ~0)

equivalent_slices_max_dev.description: extinction_factor > 1: the largest energy difference per molecule between the n symmetry-equivalent slices of one period

qeq.description: ReaxFF only (null otherwise): the QEq charges of the isolated slice against the same atoms in the bulk, in e

related_record_ids.description: surface_energy records of the same family whose gamma is this record's gamma_unrelaxed_min (the level-1 lowest termination)

gamma.description: the gamma used in the build (may be a level-1 value scaled by the relaxed/unrelaxed ratio, see basis); null in an attachment_energy shape, whose facets carry E_att and distance

E_att.description: attachment_energy shapes: E_att of the input record, kcal/mol per molecule

distance.description: the centre-to-face distance of the build when it is not gamma: |E_att| in an attachment_energy shape (the shape's distance_units)

gamma_record.description: the gamma of the input record

bfdh_area_fraction.description: BFDH (gamma ~ 1/d_eff) area fraction over the same facet set

construction.description: wulff (the default; records before 0.2.0 have no field): the equilibrium (Wulff) shape, centre-to-face distance = gamma; attachment_energy: the growth morphology, distance = |E_att| (growth rate ~ |E_att|, Hartman-Perdok), on the same lattice with the same orbits and checks

level.description: 1: unrelaxed values only; 2: relaxed only; best: relaxed where available, else level 1 scaled by the mean relaxed/unrelaxed ratio (wulffhound engine); ae-static: the static (unrelaxed) attachment-energy growth morphology (construction attachment_energy)

weighted_surface_energy.description: area-weighted distance: gamma, or |E_att| in an attachment_energy shape

volume.description: in (gamma units)^3: the shape is scaled by gamma

aspect_ratios.description: extents along the principal axes of the vertex cloud, e1 >= e2 >= e3: e2/e1 and e3/e1

checks.description: the conventions checks: pymatgen keeps the data-file a, b, c and its reciprocal-lattice symmetry gives the Laue orbits (2/m asserted)
